title: Children of Blood and Bone
author: Tomi Adeyemi
summary: In a West African-inspired kingdom, magic was wiped out by a brutal king, and those with the potential to wield it are persecuted. A young woman whose mother was killed races to bring magic back with the help of a runaway princess and her brother.
readIf: you want an energetic, high-stakes young-adult fantasy about oppression and rebellion.
skipIf: you want a gentle story, as the book has a lot of fight scenes and shifting points of view.

pairings.reason: Another story where a young person's anger at an unjust regime turns into a movement.
A fast, brutal story of rebellion against a rigid caste system, for an older audience.
Another young-adult fantasy of resistance under an oppressive empire, with alternating narrators.
